svg.title: Generic installation: everything runs in the cluster
svg.text: Generic installation: everything runs in the cluster
No Azure service needed. Kafka, Keycloak, PostgreSQL, secrets and monitoring are in-cluster; log storage is any S3 API (Azure Blob for now).
ingesters: 3 zones, RF 3, WAL on PVC
keyVault.enabled: false · postgres.provider: percona · keycloak.install: true · auth.provider: keycloak · monitoring.prometheusOperator.enabled: true
The Loki backend (rows 1-3) is identical to the Azure installation (picture 09): only the services around it change.
Manifests per component: manifests/generic/ (scripts/render-manifests.sh). Install: scripts/install.sh generic.
Not in the cluster: the users' browsers, DNS names for Grafana and Keycloak, and (until s3-storage.yaml) the Blob account.
